# Parse the old songs file content
old_songs_content = old_songs_file["content"]
old_songs_entries = []
for line in old_songs_content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
        continue
    if line.startswith("- "):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artists
        if " by " in line:
            title_part, artists_part = line.split(" by ", 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(",")]
            old_songs_entries.append({"title": title, "artists": artists})
        else:
            # No artists? treat as just title
            old_songs_entries.append({"title": line.strip(), "artists": []})

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs_entries)} old songs:")
for entry in old_songs_entries:
    print(f"  {entry['title']} by {', '.join(entry['artists'])}")
